PILOT SOURCING PACKAGE

Send us the thing
you can’t source.

Within seven days, we’ll come back with up to three quotes, each showing the full delivered cost in AUD.

WHAT WE NEED

A rough brief is enough to start.

  • A drawing, photo or sketch—even a rough one
  • Rough sizes and how many
  • Where it is going and when you need it
  • Any quote you already have, so we know what to beat

WHAT YOU GET BACK

One clear comparison.

  • Up to three makers who can actually produce it
  • One comparison sheet in AUD, delivered to your site
  • Inclusions, exclusions and lead-time assumptions
  • An honest answer—including “this is cheaper locally” if that is true

WHERE WE CAN HELP

01

Fabricated elements

Architectural metalwork, staircases, façade components, glazing-related elements and specialist finishes.

02

Custom prefab

Precast, joinery and project-specific components where local supply, price or lead time is blocking the design.

03

Unusual requests

The strongest brief is a real item you have already struggled to source. The customer chooses the category—not us.

PRICE

Free for our first 10 projects.

There is no obligation to order. Pricing after the pilot is still being tested; no fee or margin is charged without agreeing it with you first.

PILOT BOUNDARIES

Human-led, not automated.

We do not take online payments. We do not provide engineering or regulatory approval. The pilot begins supply-to-site; installation may be shown only as an allowance where it has been separately scoped.
